edits.old: The completion report of 28 March 2020 rated outcome Satisfactory, Bank performance Moderately Satisfactory and monitoring and evaluation quality Modest (Implementation Completion and Results Report, 28 March 2020; IEG ICR Review ICRR0022097, 26 June 2020).
edits.new: The completion report of 28 March 2020 rated outcome Satisfactory, efficiency Substantial, Bank performance Moderately Satisfactory and monitoring and evaluation quality Modest (Implementation Completion and Results Report, 28 March 2020, paragraph 63 and Table 4). ICRR0022097, the Independent Evaluation Group's review of that report, disagreed: it rated the outcome Moderately Satisfactory and efficiency Modest, citing four years of implementation in which only a third of the loan was disbursed for want of counterpart financing and the withdrawal of Suizhong and the Longcheng district of Chaoyang, which cut the estimated project cost from US$339.5 million to US$216.3 million (IEG ICR Review ICRR0022097).

liaoning-coastal-zone-resettlement.why: Round 20's whole-text check found the role gave only the completion report's ratings while citing the review without its verdict. Both ratings verified in both documents: the report at paragraph 63 and Table 4 gives efficiency Substantial and outcome Satisfactory; the review's section 5 gives efficiency Modest and its section 11 table gives outcome Moderately Satisfactory, with its stated reason moderate shortcomings in progress towards the outcomes. The review's 26 June 2020 date is removed from the citation because nine of twelve reviews in this batch carry no date anywhere on the page and that one came from the card itself, not from the document.
